The histology is not significantly different from that of seborrheic keratosis. DPN does not pose any health dangers, but patients often seek removal due to aesthetic concerns since it occurs commonly on the face. 此為罕見外陰部良性毛囊上皮腫瘤，病因為局部角質細胞鱗狀旋渦狀增生（可能與慢性刺激或 HPV 相關），與黑色素生成路徑完全無關。HQ 無任何合理作用機轉。TxGNN 高分預測可能源於知識圖譜中皮膚角化病變節點的圖譜距離，而非直接生物學關聯。

clinical_trials.title: The Efficacy of Salicylic Acid Peels Combined With 4% Hydroquinone Cream Versus 4% Hydroquinone Cream Alone in the Treatment of Hispanic Women With Moderate to Severe Melasma
clinical_trials.brief_summary: This study will enroll 20 adult Hispanic women. Participants will apply 4% hydroquinone cream twice daily to affected areas on the face for 14 weeks and half the face will be peeled with 20-30% salicylic acid every two weeks for a total of 4 peels. The first two peels will be 20% salicylic acid and the second two peels will be with 30% salicylic acid. The purpose of the study will be to evaluate the safety and efficacy of salicylic acid combined with 4% hydroquinone versus 4% hydroquinone alone.

literature.title: An Unusual Presentation of Lichen Planus Pigmentosus Inversus Responsive to Topical Tacrolimus: A Case Report.
literature.abstract: Lichen planus pigmentosus inversus (LPPI) is a rare variant of lichen planus pigmentosus (LPP), characterized by sharply defined violaceous-brown to gray macules, papules, patches, or plaques primarily affecting the intertriginous and flexural areas. Unlike LPP, which predominantly affects Fitzpatrick skin types III to IV in sun-exposed areas, LPPI spares these regions and has been predominantly reported in White and Asian patients.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 扁平苔癬（Lichen Planus）為 CD8+ T 細胞介導的自體免疫性皮膚黏膜病變，常伴隨炎症後色素沉著（PIH）。HQ 可透過酪氨酸酶抑制減少 PIH 的新增色素，但對苔癬本體（免疫病理）無治療效果，屬症狀輔助而非疾病修飾。適用範疇侷限於色素管理，非根本治療。
脂漏性皮膚炎以 Malassezia 酵母菌過度增生、皮脂腺功能異常及先天免疫失調為主要病因，與黑色素生成路徑無直接關聯。HQ 缺乏抗真菌、抗炎或皮脂腺調控機轉，無法解決 SD 的核心病理。TxGNN 高分預測可能源於 SD 有時伴隨色素不均的圖譜節點相近性，而非直接生物學依據。
外陰鱗狀腫瘤（VIN/VSCC）以 HPV 整合、p53 突變及鱗狀上皮細胞惡性轉化為主要分子病理。HQ 非抗腫瘤藥物，缺乏抗增殖或免疫調節機轉。⚠️ 安全疑慮：動物研究顯示高劑量 HQ 有腎毒性，部分研究提示潛在腫瘤促進疑慮（儘管臨床外用劑量風險低）。無任何支持性臨床依據，腫瘤適應症須格外謹慎。
環狀萎縮性扁平苔癬為 T 細胞介導之自體免疫病變，以表皮萎縮及基底膜帶破壞為特徵。HQ 缺乏免疫調節或抗纖維化機轉，無法影響疾病核心病理。此亞型極為罕見，無任何 HQ 相關研究依據。
肥厚性扁平苔癬以慢性苔蘚化增生（角質細胞過度增殖）及持續性炎症浸潤為特徵。雖可能伴隨局部色素沉著，但主要病程非黑色素合成異常。HQ 缺乏抗炎或抗纖維化機轉，無法解決角質增生與炎症的核心病理，色素改善效益亦有限（已沉積的噬黑素細胞色素難以清除）。

literature.title: Unilateral Distribution of Lichen Planus Pigmentosus-Inversus Unresponsive to Clobetasol and Hydroquinone.
literature.abstract: Lichen planus pigmentosus-inversus (LPP-inversus) is a rare, pigmented variant of lichen planus of unknown etiology. This skin condition typically affects the intertriginous and flexural regions of the body bilaterally. We report an unusual case presentation with unilateral distribution of LPP-inversus in a woman originally from Nepal. The lesions developed rapidly over a three-month period and were recalcitrant to therapy with topical clobetasol and hydroquinone.

literature.abstract: Lichen planus pigmentosus (LPP) is a rare variant of lichen planus. Due to the scarce number of patients diagnosed with LPP, there are no treatment guidelines. Multiple topical and oral agents are utilized in LPP with varying degrees of response. Isotretinoin has only been investigated in a case report and a single prospective pilot study for managing LPP. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: LPP 以基底層黑色素細胞破壞後的噬黑素細胞（melanophage）色素沉積為特徵，理論上 HQ 酪氨酸酶抑制可減少新增黑色素合成。然而：(1) 已沉積的噬黑素細胞色素對 HQ 的反應極差；(2) 文獻顯示療效不一甚至無效（PMID 34567907）；(3) ⚠️ 長期使用 HQ 本身可引起外源性褐黃病（exogenous ochronosis），其色素沉積形態與 LPP 高度相似，形成診斷/治療的惡性循環（PMID 38954615）。風險效益比需謹慎評估。
慢性萎縮性肢端皮炎為 Borrelia burgdorferi 晚期萊姆病皮膚表現，病理為螺旋體持續感染引起的真皮纖維化及萎縮，與黑色素生成路徑完全無關。HQ 無抗螺旋體或抗纖維化活性。TxGNN 預測可能源於皮膚科疾病圖譜節點的拓撲距離，無任何生物學意義，不具再利用研究價值。
